# Frozen grandfather list for schema_lock_check_test.go (Epic #5978).
#
# Each line is <file>|<function or ->|<normalised statement>: a CREATE INDEX without
# CONCURRENTLY, or an ADD CONSTRAINT without NOT VALID / USING INDEX, that already
# existed before the lock-hazard check did.
#
# This list may only shrink. Entries may only be removed: the check fails when a line
# matches no flagged statement in the tree, so rewriting or deleting a statement forces
# deleting its line. Adding a line is a reviewed exception, the same posture as
# scripts/complexity/manifest.json. A new index on an existing table uses CONCURRENTLY,
# a new foreign key or check constraint uses NOT VALID, and a statement on a table
# created in the same schema version carries a schema:new-table marker instead. A moved
# or edited statement is a new statement and needs one of those.
